IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Tuesday, July 28, 2026**

**LU-481 Indianapolis, IN** is running hot with **$54.75 top scale** and 42 calls chasing 143 hands. Ermco's got 19 JWs on the Google Data Center in Mooresville (outdoor new construction, 5-10s + Saturday 8s) and another 10 at the Malarchy Shingles Factory in Franklin—same schedule, drug test required. Electric Plus is staffing IU Hospital downtown (5-10s + Saturday, OSHA10 mandatory). This is bread-and-butter work with solid hours and zero screwing around.

**LU-583 El Paso, TX** opens **$55/hr flat** with Summit Line's 36-call spree and Rosendin's 32-call stack, though Rosendin dangles only **$40 base + $15 incentive** for 90% of 60-hour weeks. NM State JIW License EE98J and OSHA 10 are table stakes. Fire alarm and VESDA experience moves you up the board faster.

**LU-379 Charlotte, NC** shows 12 calls but Industrial Electric is **paying $10 over scale** (top hits **$48.75 total**) for the LNR Data Center in Lenoir—6-10s Monday-Saturday. Miller Electric's holding steady at QTS in Rock Hill (5-10s + 1-8) with Foreman Zach Klutz running point. Gross Electric adds another layer with **$4 above scale** at MOC-1 in Spartanburg, outside work, yard cleanup.

**LU-494 Milwaukee, WI** cranks 40 calls but the Port Washington Data Center jobs (Gurtz, MJ, Cupertino) all read **JW wage + $10/hr premium** for 50–60 hour weeks. Gurtz demands REPOS; MJ and Cupertino want drug tests. Pieper's service truck gig pays foreman scale locally but keeps hours tighter. Book depth is thin (188 hands on 40 calls).

**LU-430 Racine, WI** is locked on Microsoft Mount Pleasant at **$62.51/hr**—Gerdes, Pieper, Staff Electric, Kelso Burnett all running the same job, same rate. WI reciprocal JIW or 2+ verified years in-state. Long sleeves, safety-toe boots, and conduit bending are non-negotiable.

**LU-237 Niagara Falls, NY** has 7 calls but Ferguson, O'Connell, and BESCO are all loading Lake Mariner Data Center with 7/10s (6:30am–5pm), per diem live, and first-shift orientation—92 hands chasing 7 calls means Book 1 is getting thin fast.

**Market trend:** Data center work is pulling hands north and east; Indiana and Charlotte are absorbing bodies fastest, while Wisconsin and upstate New York are offering stability at solid scale with per diem backup.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Tuesday, July 28, 2026**

**LU-71 Columbus, OH** is the board's heavyweight right now—46 calls burning with **New River Electric Corp** chewing through 40 JWs on distribution work at **$125 night per diem plus $125 bonus on 10-hour days**, 6-10s with a CDL. Another 9 hands heading south into Ohio distro on 4-10s. **Capital Electric Line** wants 6 more for splicing work in Johnstown at **$100/day per diem**. Book depth is real here—140 hands available, which means you're competing, but the volume and bonus structure make this a serious play.

**LU-583 El Paso, TX** is firing on all cylinders—10 calls, roughly 105 hands in book, and **Summit Line, Rosendin, B&D Industries, and Cupertino** all posting **$55/hr inside JW rates with all OT double time**. Rosendin's sweetener is **$15/hr incentive for hitting 90% of a 60-hour week**—that's real money if you can grind it. NM State JIW License required across most calls. This is premium inside work, competitive but high-dollar.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** landed the data-center gold—Parsons Electric's Polaris Forge build is **$44.80/hr plus $100/day per diem (non-taxed), extra $100/day for ND license**, working 6-10s. The OT sweetener is there if you stack Sat/Sun at **$150 incentive pay**. 20 calls spread across Grand Forks Air Base work too. Book's thin (55 hands), so turnaround is fast.

**LU-1393 Indianapolis, IN** shows **ARC American posting $64.66/hr** on 12.5k distribution rebuilds in Wanatah—clean transmission work without per diem beating. Newkirk's Ball State T-Line rebuild pays **$51.79/hr with $200/day per diem**, older scale but solid per diem structure.

**LU-84 Newnan, GA** pairs grid experience with **$46.80/hr from Inception Energy** in Savannah plus **$100/day per diem**, statewide call. Fairway's Columbus gig onboards 8/3 for the same rate.

Data-center infrastructure and transmission rebuilds are absorbing the board's biggest call volume right now—seasonal fire season tree work notwithstanding.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Tuesday, July 28, 2026**

**LU-140 Salt Lake City, UT** is running hot with 18 calls and 61 hands needed—the fattest board in today's dispatch. BCS Mechanical is pulling 28 bodies total across two massive phases of the Sego Project (West Valley), both hitting 4-10s starting Aug 3 with full OT kicks. That's 15 journeyman pipefitters and 13 journeymen plumbers, plus 5 apprentices if you're climbing the ladder. DSI's QTS data center in Eagle Mountain adds another 6 fitters on a 5-10 with weekend swing, $10.00 per diem bump. Book depth here is real—this is where volume matters.

**LU-208 Denver, CO** sits second with 21 calls across 38 hands. Murphy's Iron Mountain data center is currently running 5-10s and ramping to 6-10s Aug 5—solid escalation signal. US Eng. Metalworks wants 9 bodies in the night shift shop with stainless fitting specs if you've got them. Olson's pulling 3 fitters into Parker Advent Hospital on 4-10s. This is hybrid work: fab shop, hospital, and industrial data center all simultaneously.

**LU-776 Lima, OH** brings shutdown pay and incentive structure: Bmwc's Nutrien shutdown is running dayshift with **$16.50/hr OT/DT rates** and **$11/hr incentive on straight time**, or **$150/day per diem** if you're over 50 miles out. Graham and Nooter both need DISA-current fitters for Cenovus maintenance and fab work. Gem's fab shop is testing 7 combo welders—no pyramiding on bennies here, so watch your math on long stretches.

**LU-213 St John, NB** is the Canadian wild card: Irving Oil Refinery has 10 journeyman pipefitter slots under Stuart Olson (GPMA short-term), another 7 under unnamed contractor (day-to-night shift switch), plus Colson Cove in Sunny Corner for pipe weld buffing. That's 20 hands in industrial refinery work—book depth is clear.

**LU-290 Portland, OR** and **LU-192 Cheyenne, WY** round out the call sheet with specialty demand: Portland's chasing orbital welders and BIM detailers for Intel Ronler Acres; Cheyenne's Holly Frontier Sinclair shutdown needs DISA-cleared welders, and Ellsworth AFB is paying **$100/day per diem** for combo welders and fitters in Box Elder, South Dakota.

The market is pivoting hard toward data centers and refinery maintenance—industrial scale work that runs long and needs bodies yesterday.
